history.summary: Preserve single financial owner while adding bounded two-way Market supplier stock, exact native bulk budgets and replay-safe coin/payroll/founding operations.

Standalone Settlements extracts the existing currency/native merchant implementation and resources into shared JEMCurrencyCore. Current source references now identify the sole existing owner; original Economy paths remain historical evidence. No balance, supply, Coin ID, legacy save identity or price change is caused by this source relocation.

Ordinary server boot exposed JPMS split packages between Economy and Core before world loading. Full-only client/market/audit implementations move into com.siirio.jemeconomy.full; shared currency API packages, balances, registry IDs and saved state remain unchanged. Exact previous paths are retained as historical evidence.

Current installed artifact and exact source-set evidence references follow migrated Economy1.3.0/Settlements2.1.0 and the sole Core resource owner. Selector membership, prices, saved balances and prior historical evidence are unchanged.
